@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used the equivalent initial prompt with an explicit
+instruction to preserve the existing square framing and photographic texture. Ondra's
+prompt also requested enough room for his entire head and shoulders while preserving his
+receding hairline, because the source crops his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

   one díl without the list ever becoming a ranking. The draw is local state and

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..365effb7a736b40751918234e6e580c41d80f374

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used the equivalent initial prompt with an explicit
+instruction to preserve the existing square framing and photographic texture. Ondra's
+prompt also requested enough room for his entire head and shoulders while preserving his
+receding hairline, because the source crops his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

diff --git a/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used the equivalent initial prompt with an explicit
+instruction to preserve the existing square framing and photographic texture. Ondra's
+prompt also requested enough room for his entire head and shoulders while preserving his
+receding hairline, because the source crops his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

diff --git a/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

diff --git a/businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaPortraits.md b/businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaPortraits.md

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..365effb7a736b40751918234e6e580c41d80f374
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaPortraits.md
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used the equivalent initial prompt with an explicit
+instruction to preserve the existing square framing and photographic texture. Ondra's
+prompt also requested enough room for his entire head and shoulders while preserving his
+receding hairline, because the source crops his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

diff --git a/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

   one díl without the list ever becoming a ranking. The draw is local state and

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used the equivalent initial prompt with an explicit
+instruction to preserve the existing square framing and photographic texture. Ondra's
+prompt also requested enough room for his entire head and shoulders while preserving his
+receding hairline, because the source crops his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

diff --git a/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

   one díl without the list ever becoming a ranking. The draw is local state and

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used the equivalent initial prompt with an explicit
+instruction to preserve the existing square framing and photographic texture. Ondra's
+prompt also requested enough room for his entire head and shoulders while preserving his
+receding hairline, because the source crops his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

diff --git a/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7a6b15c59fef592d3e63bf7fcb0fcbc96ca01041
--- /dev/null
+++ b/businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaPortraits.md
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used this initial prompt:
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: existing podcast person's portrait for a
+> small circular website avatar. EDIT TARGET: the supplied photograph. Remove only the
+> background and any fragment of another person at the edge, producing a real transparent
+> PNG with alpha. Keep THIS person's face, identity, facial proportions, expression, pose,
+> hair, beard, ears, clothing and photographic texture unchanged. Do not redraw, beautify,
+> relight or invent a new person. Keep the current square framing and scale: complete top
+> of hair with a small 5 percent top margin, centered head and shoulders, shoulders extending
+> to bottom edge. Clean natural hair edges, no visible coloured fringe, no halo. No background,
+> gradient, white fill, checkerboard pattern, shadow, text, watermark or circle drawn into
+> the image. Output a single square transparent PNG of exactly this same person.
+
+Ondra's prompt adds this instruction because the source crops his forehead:
+
+> Keep his actual receding hairline and balding head. Reframe enough to fit his entire head
+> and both shoulders, with clear margin above the scalp; do not crop his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.

 /**

  *
  * Almost every portrait is cut from the cover picture of an episode the person sat in, because the show photographs
- * its own line-up against one background and therefore already owns a picture of everyone. Whoever the show never put

diff --git a/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..3043941a4308edb8c333e1f8fa825d8c9683236a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits/verify-page.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+const { chromium, expect } = require('@playwright/test');
+const FILE_SYSTEM = require('node:fs/promises');
+const ASSERT = require('node:assert/strict');
+const OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = '.tmp/ai-ta-krajta-portraits';
+const PAGE_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:4009/ai-ta-krajta';
+
+async function main() {
+    const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
+    try {
+        const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 1080 } });
+        const errors = [];
+        page.on('pageerror', (error) => errors.push(error.message));
+        await page.addInitScript(() => {
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiesAccepted', 'true');
+            localStorage.setItem('cookiePreferences', JSON.stringify({ necessary: true, analytics: false, marketing: false }));
+        });
+        await page.goto(PAGE_URL + '#lidi', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        const cards = page.locator('#lidi li');
+        await expect(cards).toHaveCount(25);
+        const report = [];
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            const portrait = card.locator('img');
+            await portrait.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            const details = await portrait.evaluate((element) => ({
+                name: element.alt,
+                source: element.getAttribute('src'),
+                width: element.width,
+                height: element.height,
+                background: getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).backgroundImage,
+            }));
+            ASSERT.equal(details.width, 96);
+            ASSERT.equal(details.height, 96);
+            ASSERT.match(details.source, /^\/people\/ai-ta-krajta\/.+\.png$/);
+            ASSERT.match(details.background, /linear-gradient/);
+            await card.getByRole('button').hover();
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+            report.push(details);
+        }
+        await page.mouse.move(0, 0);
+        for (let index = 0; index < 25; index += 6) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/desktop-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        const target = cards.filter({ has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Petr Šimeček', exact: true }) });
+        const targetButton = target.getByRole('button');
+        await targetButton.focus();
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab');
+        ASSERT.equal(await targetButton.evaluate((element) => element.matches(':focus-visible')), true);
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('matrix(1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0)');
+        await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
+        await expect(page).toHaveURL(/person=petr-simecek.*#dily/);
+        await expect(targetButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
+        const smallPortraits = page.locator('#dily img[src^="/people/ai-ta-krajta/"]');
+        ASSERT.ok(await smallPortraits.count() > 0);
+        for (const portrait of await smallPortraits.all()) {
+            await expect.poll(() => portrait.evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+            ASSERT.equal(await portrait.getAttribute('width'), '34');
+        }
+        await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/episode-credits.png` });
+        await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
+        await targetButton.hover();
+        await expect.poll(() => target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element).transform)).toBe('none');
+        ASSERT.equal(await target.locator('img').evaluate((element) => getComputedStyle(element.parentElement).transitionDuration), '0s');
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
+        for (const card of await cards.all()) {
+            await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+            const bounds = await card.boundingBox();
+            ASSERT.ok(bounds.x >= 0 && bounds.x + bounds.width <= 390);
+            await expect.poll(() => card.locator('img').evaluate((element) => element.complete && element.naturalWidth)).toBe(320);
+        }
+        for (const index of [0, 10, 24]) {
+            await cards.nth(index).evaluate((element) => window.scrollTo(0, element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 90));
+            await page.screenshot({ path: `${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/mobile-${index + 1}.png` });
+        }
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 740 });
+        ASSERT.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth), true);
+        ASSERT.deepEqual(errors, []);
+        await FILE_SYSTEM.writeFile(`${OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/browser-review.json`, JSON.stringify({ portraits: report, browserErrors: errors, checks: ['all 25 portraits loaded', 'all 25 hover states', 'keyboard focus and filtering', '34px episode portraits', 'reduced motion', '390px and 320px mobile overflow'] }, null, 2));
+        console.log('Passed: 25 portraits, hover, keyboard filtering, episode credits, reduced motion, mobile layout.');
+    } finally {
+        await browser.close();
+    }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7a6b15c59fef592d3e63bf7fcb0fcbc96ca01041

@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+# AI ta Krajta portraits
+
+The page uses the 25 transparent, 320 × 320 PNGs in `public/people/ai-ta-krajta/`.
+Every file contains the person only. `AiTaKrajtaPersonAvatar` supplies the neutral gradient,
+circular clipping, and hover/focus treatment for both the 96-pixel cards and 34-pixel episode credits.
+The background variation is stable by person ID, independent of roster ordering.
+
+## Sources
+
+The original files in `public/people/` remain available for other pages. The JPEGs below
+were prepared by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, which records the original
+publisher URLs, episode credits, and crop coordinates. Running that script refreshes
+source crops; it does **not** replace the normalized PNGs.
+
+| Person | Source in `public/people/` |
+| --- | --- |
+| Pavol Hejný | `pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png` |
+| Jiří Jahn | `jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png` |
+| Petr Glaser | `petr-glaser.jpg` |
+| Patrik Braborec | `patrik-braborec.jpg` |
+| Jacek Soubusta | `jacek-soubusta.jpg` |
+| Šimon Podhajský | `simon-podhajsky.jpg` |
+| Roman Baranovič | `roman-baranovic.jpg` |
+| Katka Fajmanová | `katka-fajmanova.jpg` |
+| Prokop Simek | `prokop-simek.jpg` |
+| Matyáš Křeček | `matyas-krecek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Koblížek | `tomas-koblizek.jpg` |
+| Adam Zvada | `adam-zvada.jpg` |
+| Lukáš Caha | `lukas-caha.jpg` |
+| Richard Mládek | `richard-mladek.jpg` |
+| Dalibor Krejčí | `dalibor-krejci.jpg` |
+| Petr Brzek | `petr-brzek.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Kroupa | `tomas-kroupa.jpg` |
+| Ondřej Sukač | `ondrej-sukac.jpg` |
+| Tomáš Mikolov | `tomas-mikolov.jpg` |
+| Jan Cienciala | `jan-cienciala.jpg` |
+| Lenka Šefčáková | `lenka-sefcakova.jpg` |
+| Pavel Ungr | `pavel-ungr.jpg` |
+| Matouš Havlena | `matous-havlena.jpg` |
+| Ondra | `ondra.jpg` |
+
+Petr Šimeček's portrait comes from his [Datascript conference speaker profile](https://www.datascript.cz/it-konference/agentic-ai-2026-next-generation-ai-agent-engineering/),
+using the [original photograph](https://www.datascript.cz/ir/storage/d5_DS-PrednaskySpeaker/79-image-File-PESI.png).
+Its biography matches the guest of episode 6: time-series forecasting at Google,
+Mediaboard, and Masaryk University. His GitHub avatar has balloons covering his face
+and is not suitable for this portrait.
+
+## Cutout workflow
+
+Pavol and Jiří reuse the existing transparent originals, downscaled to 304 × 304 and
+padded with transparency (16 pixels above, 8 on each side) on the 320-pixel canvas.
+The other 23 portraits were edited individually with the built-in imagegen tool,
+then downscaled with Sharp to 320 × 320 and saved as PNG with alpha and compression level 9.
+No image-generation service runs in the page or at build time.
+
+Prompt used for the cutouts (each supplied photo is the edit target):
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: podcast person's head-and-shoulders avatar.
+> Edit the supplied photo: remove its entire background and any sliver of another person,
+> keeping ONLY the central person. Real transparent PNG alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
+> Preserve the person's exact facial identity, proportions, expression, pose, gaze, skin
+> texture, hair, beard, glasses, clothing and lighting; do not beautify or invent details.
+> Square composition, centered head and shoulders extending to bottom edge, entire hair/head
+> inside frame with about 5% transparent margin above, face around 40% of image height.
+> Clean hair edges without background fringes or halos. No text, outline, new objects or
+> drawn circle. One portrait only.
+
+Petr Glaser and Patrik Braborec used this initial prompt:
+
+> Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: existing podcast person's portrait for a
+> small circular website avatar. EDIT TARGET: the supplied photograph. Remove only the
+> background and any fragment of another person at the edge, producing a real transparent
+> PNG with alpha. Keep THIS person's face, identity, facial proportions, expression, pose,
+> hair, beard, ears, clothing and photographic texture unchanged. Do not redraw, beautify,
+> relight or invent a new person. Keep the current square framing and scale: complete top
+> of hair with a small 5 percent top margin, centered head and shoulders, shoulders extending
+> to bottom edge. Clean natural hair edges, no visible coloured fringe, no halo. No background,
+> gradient, white fill, checkerboard pattern, shadow, text, watermark or circle drawn into
+> the image. Output a single square transparent PNG of exactly this same person.
+
+Ondra's prompt adds this instruction because the source crops his forehead:
+
+> Keep his actual receding hairline and balding head. Reframe enough to fit his entire head
+> and both shoulders, with clear margin above the scalp; do not crop his forehead.
+
+When updating a portrait, compare it with the source, inspect hair and glasses against
+the page gradient, and check the actual circular avatar at both sizes. Keep complete
+heads, similar face scale, and shoulders reaching the bottom. Do not bake the circle,
+gradient, outline, or hover effect into the PNG. `aiTaKrajtaPeople.test.ts` checks every
+roster entry for a real, uniformly sized PNG with transparent and opaque pixels.
